independent_ripple.scope: Matched effective-ripple proxy diagnostic, not transport or confinement qualification
caveats: acc_req controls rational length; the API does not return an epsilon tolerance-converged flag.
All cases preserve signed rotational transform and use the reviewed negative-iota period-count patch.
A sampled transport proxy does not certify action invariance, distinct pwO geometry, alpha confinement, bootstrap current, or DKE convergence.
independent_ripple.negative_result: The optimized candidate has larger epsilon_eff^(3/2) than its matched seed at every sampled surface in the measured rungs.
